verdict.rationale: Jan is an open-source ChatGPT replacement whose app ecosystem runs entirely on your own hardware. It can be built and launched from source, and its OpenAI-compatible API server runs locally on localhost:1337 and can optionally be exposed to other devices on your network via 0.0.0.0. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment, and documentation of headless/server-style (multi-user or containerized) hosting beyond the desktop app.
